messages:
ops-bot: ALERT AUTO: service=text-gen region=us-east-1 trigger=latency_p95>900ms for 4m severity=page
michelle_oncall: I'm on the bridge. seeing p95 and some 5xxs, tagging jamal
jamal_sre: joining bridge. quick glance: sudden kv-cache eviction spike + upstream retry amplification. also a small bump in queue length on pool-warm-02
alice_prod: reported by support: several EU users saw slow responses; may be cross-region fallback to us-east-1
jamal_sre: short mitigation idea: route EU fallback to secondary regional replica (warm pool) while we stabilize cache; also limit per-host concurrency to 80 to reduce queueing
lena_pm: what's the risk of routing change to active customers? any impact to throughput or latency for non-impacted traffic?
jamal_sre: low risk if we do progressive traffic shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2m chunks. will monitor tail latencies closely
michelle_oncall: do it. michelle -> infra: start progressive reroute; jamal, apply temporary per-host cap. keep me posted
ops-bot: ACTION: reroute initiated by michelle_oncall at 2026-03-14T03:12:10Z
jamal_sre: applying caps now. also enabling kv-cache sticky mode to reduce churn (short-term)
michelle_oncall: p95 trending down from ~1.1s to 380ms after 70% reroute. 5xxs falling. good signs
alice_prod: CS ticket CS-9910 updated with note: "Intermittent performance issues; mitigation in progress"
triage-bot: POST-INCIDENT: suggested postmortem. please add availability in #postmortems. suggested window: Wed 11:00 PT
jamal_sre: creating follow-up tickets: INFR-3601 (root cause investigation: eviction cascade + model rollout correlation), INFR-3602 (autoscaler hysteresis tuning), INFR-3603 (alerting + runbooks)
lena_pm: please include customer impact summary in INFR-3601 and draft comms for any affected enterprise tenants by EOD tomorrow
jamal_sre: proposed immediate alert changes: 1) composite page that requires both p95>800ms AND eviction_rate>threshold to page 2) raise dedupe window from 5m -> 12m for latency pages 3) add eviction-rate anomaly alert (rate increase over baseline)
alice_prod: paste the proposed promql for the composite so support and product can review
jamal_sre: draft promql snippet:
```
# composite: high p95 AND eviction surge
p95_expr = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="text-gen"}[10m])) by (le)) > 0.8
evict_expr = increase(kv_cache_evictions_total{pool=~"pool-.*"}[5m]) > 100
composite = p95_expr and evict_expr
```
jamal_sre: will change windows and thresholds after review; aim to reduce false pages from transient load
michelle_oncall: owners and deadlines
- jamal_sre: INFR-3601 root-cause doc + dashboards attached by Fri COB
- jamal_sre: push short-term kv-cache config to disable aggressive global eviction (INFR-3604) by EOD today
- alice_prod: routing fallback audit (RTE-220) by Mon
- lena_pm: customer comms draft by tomorrow EOD
- ops-team: implement composite alert and dedupe window change (MON morning)
jamal_sre: longer term items: gate model-variant rollouts with KV warmup checks, autoscaler step-delay tuning, and a post-deploy smoke test for eviction patterns
triage-bot: FOLLOWUP: postmortem meeting requested; meeting scheduled Wed 11:00 PT. owner=jamal_sre; postmortem doc INFR-3601 linked
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: service=text-gen incident_id=INC-20260314-07 duration=18m
alice_prod: adding a brief snippet to INFR-3601 for logs:
```
2026-03-14T03:09:57Z GET /v1/generate 502 upstream=evict qlen=142
2026-03-14T03:10:02Z backend concurrency spike=96
```
michelle_oncall: thanks team. jamal, take lead for postmortem and remediation tracker. I'll hand back rotation in 20m
jamal_sre: ack, will monitor through rotation and update INFR-3601 with heap profiles and eviction histograms before the postmortem
michelle_oncall: closing thread here. please update tickets with any new findings before the meeting. :wave:
